entities.summary: Carl Wilhelm Richard Hülsenbeck was a German writer, poet, and psychoanalyst born in Frankenau, Hessen-Nassau who was associated with the formation of the Dada movement. Richard Huelsenbeck was a poets & playwrights from Frankenau (1892-04-23, Frankenau–1974-04-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
